title: RTP scholarships

compensation.value: $44,293 p.a. stipend (2027 rate); tuition fee offset up to 100%
compensation.evidence_quote: RTP Stipend Scholarship | Domestic and international students Commencing or enrolled in a higher degree by research Competitively awarded | $44,293 p.a. stipend (2027 rate)

about: Australian Government Research Training Program scholarships at the University of Sydney for international research students starting in Research Periods 3 and 4, 2027. The submission deadline is 18 December 2026; the 2027 stipend rate is $44,293 per year.
requirements: International applicants for Research Periods 3 and 4, 2027
Admission application must also be submitted through Sydney Courses by the deadline
Domestic applicants have a different deadline (19 March 2027)
